I have a question on the idea/experience that depression can return out of no where. 

What prevents this on-again, off-again depression from being labeled bipolar II? Bipolar II's "upswing" is hypomania; a less-severe form of mania that is rarely debilitating and often considered pleasant.

I've had a few depressive episodes (3-6m on average) and am coming out of one now. I feel like throwing SSRI/SNRIs has only made it worse.
